questions.question: Q: What is a hypothesis?
questions.correctAnswer: A testable statement predicting the outcome of a statistical investigation.
questions.explanation: Answer: A testable statement predicting the outcome of a statistical investigation.

questions.question: Q: Write a suitable hypothesis for investigating whether Year 11 students spend more time on homework than Year 10 students.
questions.correctAnswer: Year 11 students spend more time on homework per week than Year 10 students.
questions.explanation: Answer: Year 11 students spend more time on homework per week than Year 10 students.
